headline_seed: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says - BBC
draft_text:
Zelensky says US envoys asked: "What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?" — the first time he says this linkage was raised. He'd put it to a referendum. No US official has confirmed the account. BBC News and ABC News both report.

And that's the mews.
